WHETHER YOU GET SOURCES depends on whether the model searched the web. perplexity searches on every call, so its sources are populated and it needs no parameters. The other three answer from training data unless you set web_search: true, and on local business questions they otherwise do not search at all.

WEB SEARCH SUPPORT DIFFERS BY PLATFORM. claude takes web_search, force_web_search, search_country and search_city — the full set. chat_gpt takes all four except that GPT-5 models drop force_web_search. gemini takes web_search only: a search can be permitted but never compelled, and it cannot be geographically scoped. perplexity takes search_country only and cannot be switched off. Asking for something a platform does not support returns a 400 saying what it does support.

smythmyke/patent-search-mcp-server.description:
MCP server for the AI Patent Search Generator — patent dossiers, prosecution history, Office Action AI analysis, citation/family/CPC lookups, and Google Patents search.

  Works in Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Cursor, ChatGPT-with-MCP, and any other MCP-compatible client.

  ## Tools (11)

  - **dossier** — full patent intelligence: bibliographic, claims, citations, family, classifications, examiner stats. 3 credits fresh; free on 24h cache hit.
  - **prosecution** — USPTO file-wrapper documents (Office Actions, responses, amendments). Free.
  - **oa_analyze** — AI analysis of USPTO Office Actions (rejection grounds, cited prior art, suggested response arguments). First 5/application free; 1 credit each thereafter.
  - **search** — multi-strategy patent search against Google Patents (telescoping / onion-ring / faceted). 1 credit.
  - **query** — Boolean query generator (manual paste into Google Patents). 1 credit.
  - **similar** — Google Patents similar-documents ranking. Free.
  - **citations** — backward + forward citation graph, examiner-cited flagged. Free.
  - **family** — patent family (continuations, divisionals, foreign counterparts). Free.
  - **examiner** — name, art unit, allowance rate, average pendency. Free.
  - **cpc** — CPC classification code lookup. Free.
  - **balance** — credit + subscription status. Free.

  Requires an API key minted from the AI Patent Search Generator Chrome extension's Admin tab.

USE WHEN: The user wants to know how many faces are in a local image, or needs their positions.
DO NOT USE for: text extraction (use ocr_image), barcode reading (use detect_barcodes).

Returns: JSON with the total face count and an array of face positions expressed
         as percentage of image dimensions (top, left, width, height).
tools.name: detect_faces

parameters.description: Absolute or relative path to the image file
parameters.name: path

tools.security_comment: Tool `detect_faces` [MEDIUM] reads, writes, or modifies host filesystem paths.

tools.description: Analyze text for writing style issues: weasel words, passive voice, duplicate words, long sentences, nominalizations, hedging, filler adverbs, and research-cited AI tells. tools.description: Remove duplicate adjacent words (case-insensitive, including across line breaks) and return the cleaned text plus the list of words that were removed.
